scripts.dev: pnpm dev:db > /dev/null && concurrently -k -n api,site -c magenta,green 'pnpm dev:api' 'pnpm dev:site'
scripts.dev:api: DATABASE_URL=$(../../scripts/local-postgres.sh start borsolivres) STAGE=dev tsx watch api/src/main.dev.ts
scripts.test:core: pnpm --filter @borso/infra run build && vitest run --project core --coverage
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @borso/infra run build && DATABASE_URL=$(../../scripts/local-postgres.sh start borsolivres) vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @borso/infra run build && DATABASE_URL=$(../../scripts/local-postgres.sh start borsolivres) vitest run --coverage
scripts.synth: pnpm --filter @borso/infra run build && pnpm build && cdk synth --all
scripts.diff: pnpm --filter @borso/infra run build && pnpm build && cdk diff --all
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @borso/infra run build && pnpm build && cdk synth --all && ../../scripts/preflight-cloudfront-aliases.sh cdk.out && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never
scripts.destroy: pnpm --filter @borso/infra run build && pnpm build && cdk destroy "borsolivres-pr-${PR_NUMBER:?PR_NUMBER env var required — borsolivres destroy targets the per-PR app stack only, never the shared borsolivres-cluster stack}" --force
